title: P1.0a Eval Case Schema
description: Schema for every eval case line in eval/datasets/*.jsonl. Validation is performed by the lightweight validator in eval/scripts/run_serving_eval.py (no jsonschema dependency). Each JSONL line must be one JSON object conforming to this schema.

id.description: Globally unique case id across ALL datasets, e.g. intent_001.

task_type.description: Must match the dataset file the case lives in.

input.description: Request payload for the mapped endpoint. For vision_attribute this is a manifest-only descriptor; image_uri must use the placeholder:// scheme and the runner never loads it.

expected.description: Declarative expectations consumed by the runner checkers. Supported keys include: status_code, status, primary_intent, sub_intent, required_data_keys, data_equals, required_substrings, forbidden_substrings, forbidden_answer_substrings, required_warning_codes, allowed_warning_codes, required_source_types, required_meta, required_meta_keys, min_hits, max_hits, required_hit_ids, required_fields_in_hits, content_type, min_blocked_claims, llm_used, content_blocks_present.

tags.description: Free-form coverage tags, e.g. attribute_query/fabric, synonym, empty_query.

source_ref.description: Provenance of the case (dataset/author/date/grounding). Must be an object.

notes.description: Human-readable rationale, known gaps, or caveats.

x-content-rules: No raw image_bytes content anywhere in a dataset.
No real secrets or tokens; the string SECRET_BASE64_DO_NOT_LEAK must not appear in datasets.
vision_attribute input.image_uri must start with placeholder://.
Case ids must be globally unique across all dataset files.
